parallel_fusion.rule: This delta is rebuilt from the moved current main and does not overwrite the parallel fingerprint/duplicate-create mechanism.

target.required_training: full SFT through an admitted Qwen2-compatible Together template or another owner-admitted full-FT runner without changing the target model

findings: The public Together fine-tuning supported-model table checked on 2026-08-22 lists no Qwen2/Qwen2.5 training base.
The old implicit Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-Turbo value is inference-visible but is not documented as a currently supported fine-tuning base; inference visibility is not training-template evidence.
Together BYOM requires architecture compatibility between the external Hugging Face checkpoint and the selected Together base/template.
The current estimate-price request does not expose from_hf_model or hf_model_revision, so price admission cannot establish BYOM checkpoint compatibility.
The current Together Python create API exposes both from_hf_model and hf_model_revision; the external checkpoint can therefore be pinned at actual create.

The current main idempotency mechanism did not include hf_model_revision in campaign identity and retained an implicit template default; this delta closes both gaps while preserving duplicate-create guards.

unusual_experiment.name: template_mirage_qwen35_08b_substitution
unusual_experiment.counter_reality: Use the currently documented smallest Qwen full-fine-tuning base, Qwen3.5-0.8B, as the template for Qwen2.5-0.5B because the vendor family and parameter count are close.
unusual_experiment.reason: The candidate is a different model generation and conditional-generation/multimodal architecture. Parameter-count proximity does not satisfy Together's architecture-match law.
unusual_experiment.note: The existing PR #772 ambiguous-create fault is only regression-rerun by this branch; it is not counted as a new unusual experiment.

mechanisms: remove implicit Together fine-tuning template default
require an explicitly verified Qwen2-compatible full-FT template
pin primary and ablation Hugging Face revisions
include hf_model_revision and explicit template in campaign fingerprint schema v2
preserve exact-fingerprint operator authorization and duplicate account-job guards from PR #772
extend exact PR CI to py_compile and run launcher safety regression as well as strict corpus admission

current_blocker: No currently documented Qwen2/Qwen2.5 Together full-fine-tuning template is available. A credentialed model_limits/create admission is required before Together compatibility can be claimed.
next_discriminator: Open the fused PR and require the exact-checkout corpus + launcher-safety runner. With TOGETHER_API_KEY mounted only in an authorized execution environment and a currently verified Qwen2-compatible template name, run preflight first. If model_limits rejects every Qwen2-compatible candidate, retain Qwen2.5-0.5B and change only the training runner rather than silently pivoting to Qwen3.5-0.8B.
